items.subject: Compiler-vectorized versus explicit SIMD execution
items.objective: Keep threading unchanged and compare the ordinary per-option loop as compiled by the frozen build with an explicit x86-intrinsics kernel. Use only ISA supported by the frozen target/build, with compile-time guards and a scalar fallback; do not change compiler flags or add runtime environment/ISA probing. Preserve the supplied Black-Scholes computation and CND coefficients. If vector math requires altered rounding, validate it against tolerance on varied inputs and retain a correct fallback. Measure each route separately so G can test combinations with T1 and T3.
